title: Employer Allowance Granted to Employee Meal Account Plans: Funding Schedule
content:
Where an employer funds meals as a benefit, the funding reaches the diner as employer allowance placed on their Employee Meal Account. This schedule prints how often each meal plan is granted allowance, how much, what one grant period may hold, how long a lot stays spendable, whether what is unspent rolls forward, whether allowance is prorated for part months of recorded leave, and the yearly figure above which the benefit is reported as taxable.

| Meal plan | Allowance granted | Granted each grant period | Ceiling for one grant period | A lot stays spendable for | Unspent allowance rolls forward | Prorated for part months of leave | Yearly taxable benefit ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | none | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | no | no | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | none | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | no | no | $0.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | none | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | no | no | $0.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | each service day | $9.50 | $9.50 | 1 calendar day | no | yes | $2280.00 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | each service day | $18.00 | $18.00 | 1 calendar day | no | yes | $4320.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | each calendar month | $420.00 | $420.00 | 30 calendar days | yes | yes | $5040.00 |

## Definitions carried by the schedule

1. The grant basis is how often employer allowance is granted, printed as none, each service day, each week or each calendar month.
2. The grant amount is what is granted each grant period, and the grant period ceiling is the most allowance that may be held for one grant period.
3. The expiry figure is the calendar days an allowance lot stays spendable before it lapses.
4. Rollover says whether unspent allowance rolls into the next grant period; leave proration says whether allowance is prorated for part months of leave.
5. The taxable benefit ceiling is the employer allowance in a year above which the benefit is reported as taxable.

## Distinguishing the plans

Three plans print no allowance at all: against the Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account, the Prepaid Declining Balance Account and the Payroll Deduction Meal Account the basis is none, the grant is $0.00, the ceiling is $0.00, the expiry is 0 calendar days, rollover is no, leave proration is no and the taxable ceiling is $0.00. Of the three that do carry allowance, two grant it each service day — $9.50 against the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and $18.00 against the Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account, each lot spendable for 1 calendar day and neither rolling forward — while the Executive Dining Charge Account grants $420.00 each calendar month, its lots spendable for 30 calendar days and rolling forward. The yearly taxable ceilings run $2280.00, $4320.00 and $5040.00 across those three plans in the same order.
